name: Grilled Chicken Ranch Wraps with Balsamic Tomatoes & Cucumbers

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Pat dry with paper towel and season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan or regular skillet over medium-high heat.

When the grill pan or skillet is hot, drizzle with oil and add fillets. Working in batches if necessary, grill until cooked through, about 3-4 minutes per side. When the chicken is done, set aside on a plate and cover with aluminum foil. Wipe out and reserve pan for use later.
Wash and dry the cucumbers and tomatoes. Cut the tomatoes into wedges and the cucumbers into thin, half moons; set aside.

Add vinegar to a small saucepan and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce to medium-low and continue to simmer, uncovered, until reduced by half, 7-10 minutes; remove from heat and set aside.
Combine mayonnaise and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the ranch dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup mayonnaise
1 ½ tsp dill
½ tsp parsley flakes
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp onion powder
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry spinach. (Skip if it came pre-washed.)
Thinly slice the cooked chicken into strips.
Lay the tortillas on a flat surface and divide spinach, chicken, grated cheese, and ranch dressing between them. Roll tightly to close.
Return grill pan or regular skillet to medium-high heat.
Working in batches if necessary, place wraps on the grill and cook, rotating every 1-2 minutes, until tortilla is crispy and golden. Cut each wrap in half.
To serve, divide wraps and veggies between plates. Drizzle veggies with balsamic reduction and enjoy!
